Title: Engineering & Quality - Software Engineer, Senior

As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. Our team includes the Chief Data Office, Chief Software Office, Chief Technology Office, Emerging Technology, Shared Technology Services, Technology, Risk and the Executive Program Management Office (EPMO). Driven by our investment in cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud solutions, we’re home to a diverse range of roles and backgrounds united by a shared passion for leveraging modern technology to drive projects that matter to our organization and clients. We are also proud to be recognized by Built In as a “Best Place to Work in Technology” 3 years in a row. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer an exciting and supportive environment where you can grow, innovate, and make a difference. Drive continuous improvement of data architecture, pipeline efficiency, and reusable engineering patterns to enable faster delivery and better scalability across enterprise data initiatives. You May Be a Good Fit If 5 – 8 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or data platform development, ideally within financial services or another regulated industry. Expertise in SQL and Python, including experience building APIs, data pipelines, transformation frameworks, and production-grade data solutions. Experience in designing and supporting solutions on AWS as the preferred cloud platform, with familiarity in similar cloud environments, and hands-on experience with containerization, especially Kubernetes/EKS, as well as serverless services such as AWS Lambda and event-driven architectures. Experience in working with Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Data Governance, and Data Mesh concepts, along with modern engineering practices such as CI/CD, automated testing, Agile delivery. 1-2 years of AI-enabled engineering or data tooling, such as LLM-based developer tools, prompt-enabled workflows, semantic search, RAG pipelines, vector databases, MCP-based integrations, or other tooling that supports intelligent automation and agentic use cases. Comfortable in leading technical workstreams, collaborating across cross-functional teams, and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders. What Would Make You Stand Out Experience with Collibra and related data governance, metadata management, catalog, lineage, and data quality tools. Exposure to Databricks and Snowflake for modern data engineering and analytics use cases. Familiarity with trino or similar distributed query and data mesh platforms. Awareness of or hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and platforms, as well as AI/data capabilities such as knowledge graphs, semantic search, LLM-powered applications, GPT, Amazon Q, and Microsoft Copilot. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills, with a proven ability to deliver high-quality solutions in cross-functional environments. A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. Title: Analytics Client Service Associate
Description: Your Team Responsibilities We are currently seeking an experienced Analytics Client Service Specialist to join our Client Coverage organization in Mexico City/Monterrey. The MSCI Global Client Service team is composed of experienced financial professionals that provide first tier support for our clients around the world. Team members are responsible for responding to a wide variety of methodology, usage, interpretational, and technical questions on both analytical and benchmark products. Client contact is primarily via telephone and email, but occasional travel may be required for on-site presentations or trainings. Client Service Specialists work closely with account managers and consultants to develop and maintain client relationships. Your Key Responsibilities Answer detailed client inquiries about MSCI products and methodology, with emphasis on complex L2 questions requiring quantitative and methodological expertise across Barra's multi-asset class risk framework. Participate in developing client relationships through proactive follow up on issues raised by clients. Analyze market performance and data for our clients on a reactive and a pro-active basis. Maintain relationships by ensuring relevant product and model information is shared with clients. Provide client feedback to the Coverage, Product Management, Research and Data groups. Keep up with current events and trends in the marketplace. Own end-to-end case management from intake to resolution, ensuring adherence to SLA targets, escalation protocols, and client communication standards. Mentor and develop junior team members (Analysts and Associates) through regular coaching, knowledge transfer, and structured feedback. Contribute to the team knowledge base by creating and updating articles, leading formal knowledge-sharing sessions, and promoting client self-service adoption. Accountable for translating AI capability into team-level impact — designing, building, and deploying AI-assisted solutions that improve service efficiency and team productivity. Maintain consistent personal AI tool adoption embedded in daily workflow, serving as a practitioner role model for responsible and effective AI integration within Client Service. Specific Knowledge/Skills Your skills and experience that will help you excel Strong analytic, quantitative, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated understanding of financial topics which should include some of the following: Modern Portfolio Theory, Equity and Portfolio Construction, Optimization, Cap Asset Pricing models, Multi Factor Risk Models, Market Risk, Credit Risk and VAR. Deep understanding of international financial institutions and global financial markets. Proactive and highly motivated, track record of challenging self and others to anticipate future trends and creatively capitalize on opportunities Ability to develop value-added contributions to both internal and external clients. Excellent communication skills, ability to articulate complicated concepts or methodologies verbally and in writing to senior management and clients. Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects under tight, short-term deadlines. Dynamic, track record of excelling in an environment of ambiguity by quickly adapting behavior and work methods to adjust to multiple demands and shifting priorities. Teamwork, ability to work efficiently with diverse cultures on a global team and knowing when to involve appropriate colleagues in projects regardless of function or location. Working knowledge of programming (Python, R, C++) is a plus. Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot); demonstrated ability to embed AI into daily workflows and build repeatable AI-assisted solutions that improve team productivity and service quality. Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a client-facing context, ensuring accuracy and methodological soundness before delivery. Desired Experience 5-7 years’ experience in Financial Services. Desired Qualifications Undergraduate degree in finance, economics, actuarial sciences, statistics, mathematics, or other quantitative fields required. MFE, MBA,Masters Degree and/or CFA , or equivalent highly desired. About MSCI What we offer you Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development. Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles. We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum. At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry. MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for Spanish and English language use cases and Mexico/LATAM-specific regulatory environments (LFPDPPP, data localization, INAI compliance) Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live Own customer outcomes — stay engaged Title: Sales & Data ambassador
Description: Position Moët Hennessy is looking for a Sales Ambassador – Off Trade based in Mexico City, responsible for driving sales growth, developing and strengthening strategic relationships with key retail customers, and ensuring excellent commercial execution across the Off Trade channel. This role combines strong commercial capabilities with a data-driven mindset, leveraging sales analytics, business intelligence tools, and market insights to identify growth opportunities, optimize customer performance, and support strategic decision-making. The Sales Ambassador will play a key role in managing customer performance through KPI analysis, forecasting, business reviews, and commercial planning, while maintaining close relationships with retail buyers and ensuring execution aligned with the company's luxury standards. The position requires a balance between office-based analytical work and regular customer/store visits within Mexico City to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and ensure the successful execution of commercial initiatives Job Responsibilities Commercial Management Develop and execute commercial plans aligned with sales objectives for assigned Off Trade accounts. Drive sales growth and achieve commercial targets through effective account management, assortment optimization, and customer development. Build, manage, and strengthen strategic relationships with key retail customers, distributors, buyers, and decision-makers. Lead commercial negotiations, ensuring profitable agreements, promotional compliance, and alignment with company objectives and brand standards. Identify new business opportunities to increase sales, distribution, visibility, and market share within the retail landscape. Conduct regular customer visits and store checks to review business performance, identify opportunities, and strengthen partnerships. Ensure excellent in-store execution, including visibility, shelf presence, secondary placement, promotional initiatives, and brand standards. Business Analysis & Data Management Monitor and analyze sales performance, sell-in, sell-out, depletion, inventory levels, and customer KPIs to identify opportunities and risks. Extract, consolidate, and analyze commercial data from SAP, internal systems, and external data sources (e.g., market research and retail panel data). Develop, maintain, and improve reporting dashboards and scorecards using Power BI and advanced Excel tools. Generate actionable insights through data analysis to support commercial strategies, category performance, and customer development plans. Lead sales forecasting and support demand planning activities through data-driven analysis. Analyze customer profitability, product mix performance, pricing opportunities, and market trends. Prepare monthly business reviews, commercial performance reports, and executive presentations. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all sales reporting processes. Support management decision-making through ad hoc analysis and business recommendations. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate closely with Trade Marketing, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams. Support annual planning cycles, budget reviews, and commercial initiatives with analytical insights. Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes and business performance tracking. Contribute to Commercial Excellence initiatives through data analysis, KPI monitoring, and performance management Profile Education Bachelor's degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, International Business, or a related field. Experience 2 to 4 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Excellence, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, Revenue Management, or related commercial roles. Experience within FMCG, premium beverages, consumer goods, luxury brands, retail, or related industries is preferred. Proven experience managing retail customer relationships and delivering commercial results. Strong experience in sales reporting, forecasting, KPI management, and performance analysis. Experience working with distributors and Off Trade / retail customers is highly desirable. Experience using ERP systems, preferably SAP. Demonstrated ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations. Technical Skills Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced formulas, dashboards, scenario analysis). Advanced Power BI (data modeling, dashboard creation, KPI tracking, visualization, and reporting). SAP knowledge and experience in sales reporting, customer performance analysis, and commercial data management. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities. Advanced English. Skills & Competencies Strong analytical mindset and business acumen. Ability to transform data into strategic actions and business recommendations. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. Strong commercial and relationship management capabilities. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Results-oriented, proactive, and highly organized. Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills. Ability to influence stakeholders through insights and fact-based recommendations. Strong planning, prioritization, and project management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for luxury brands and exceptional consumer experiences. Ideal Profile A commercially driven professional with strong analytical capabilities who can successfully manage key Off Trade accounts while leveraging data, reporting, and business intelligence tools to drive growth, optimize retail performance, and support strategic decision-making.
